harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created /dev/vgdata/lvdata, mounted it at /srv/data, and grew it online from 1.00 GiB to 2.25 GiB. The ext3 filesystem now provides 2.1 GiB available space, and its test content remained intact through both growth and reboot.
actions_performed: Created a persistent 3 GiB file-backed LVM physical volume because the existing disk had no unused 2 GiB extent.
Created vgdata/lvdata at 1 GiB and mounted it at /srv/data.
Extended the mounted LV and filesystem online to 2.25 GiB.
Configured CentOS 5 rc.local persistence for loop attachment, VG activation, and mounting.
Restarted node1 once and verified recovery without changing CentOS 5.11 or kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.

evidence.summary: Shows the initial 1 GiB ext3 LV mounted read-write at /srv/data with test content and its MD5 hash.

evidence.requirement: Grow to at least 2 GB while mounted and preserve contents
evidence.summary: Shows the mount before and after growth, successful online lvextend/resize2fs to 2.25 GiB, and identical before/after content hashes.
Shows the CentOS 5 boot hook and successful post-reboot restoration of the loop PV, VG, 2.25 GiB LV, ext3 mount, and payload.

Captures the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot-ID change from 69ecda2f-bd25-42b2-8000-000000000000 to d7180420-8487-4856-8000-000000000000, and recovered mount, capacity, LVM state, OS/kernel, hash, and data.
